SELECT DISTINCT a.account_name, SUM(u.events) AS total_events
FROM user_daily_activity u
JOIN accounts a ON u.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id != 189
GROUP BY a.account_name
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN account_id = 189 THEN events ELSE 0 END) AS our_events,
  SUM(CASE WHEN account_id = 115 THEN events ELSE 0 END) AS their_events
FROM user_daily_activity
WHERE (account_id = 189 OR account_id = 115) 
  AND activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

  SELECT account_id, SUM(events) AS total_events
  FROM user_daily_activity
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT account_id, total_events
FROM account_events
WHERE total_events = (SELECT MAX(total_events) FROM account_events)

SELECT rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(events) AS total_events,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(events) DESC) AS rank
    FROM user_daily_activity
    WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
    GROUP BY account_id
) AS ranked_accounts
WHERE account_id = 112

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * account_events / total_events, 1) AS share
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(events) AS account_events
    FROM user_daily_activity
    WHERE account_id = 112
      AND activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
) a
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(events) AS total_events
    FROM user_daily_activity
    WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
) t

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * our_events / total_events, 1) AS share
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(events) AS our_events
    FROM user_daily_activity
    WHERE account_id = 189
      AND activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
) AS o
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(events) AS total_events
    FROM user_daily_activity
    WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
) AS t

SELECT SUM(uda.events) AS events
FROM user_daily_activity AS uda
JOIN accounts AS a ON uda.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 189
  AND a.country = 'Germany'
  AND uda.activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
